findings.detail: The archivedManagement predicate rejects the exact 'Archived · view only' marker and restoration link but never counts archived membership name nodes or unexpected organization content. A guest Organization section containing an archived name alone still satisfies every T92 check, contrary to the inventory's no archived membership details criterion. Add a structural guest content count/absence assertion and a mutation that exposes a name without the marker.
